description: AI news digest Sep 16: Gemini voice agents, Jev structured decisions, Salesforce Koa reasoning, private browsing, world model.
lead: Voice agents, structured machine decisions, and enterprise reasoning lead the last 24 hours. Google shipped live dialogue models built for background tool use, a new startup rethinks model output as typed probabilities, and Salesforce post-trained a CRM reasoning model on Nemotron. Mistral and Mozilla pair open models with private browsing, Odyssey previews one world model across robots and cars, the OpenAI Foundation funds biology datasets, and OpenAI details safety cases before big training runs. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 16, 2026: voice agents, structured decisions, and open browsing
